review.tagline: Pretrained decoder-only models that forecast financial candlestick (K-line) series
review.summary: Kronos is a family of decoder-only Transformers pretrained on OHLCV candlestick data from over 45 exchanges. A tokenizer quantizes K-lines into hierarchical discrete tokens, and the model forecasts future bars through a KronosPredictor class with temperature and top-p sampling. Weights for mini, small and base are on Hugging Face, and the repo includes a Qlib-based fine-tuning and backtest pipeline.
review.audience: Quant researchers and ML engineers forecasting candlestick time series
strengths: Open weights at 4.1M, 24.7M and 102.3M params on Hugging Face
Few-line predict and predict_batch API returning pandas DataFrames
Includes tokenizer and predictor fine-tuning scripts with a Qlib backtest example
MIT license; paper accepted at AAAI 2026
weaknesses: Context limited to 512 tokens, except 2048 for Kronos-mini
Batch prediction requires identical lookback and pred_len across all series
Fine-tuning example is a demo, not a production trading system; no releases tagged
needs: Needs PyTorch, Hugging Face Hub, pyqlib (fine-tuning only), Comet.ml (optional)
Models: Kronos-mini, Kronos-small, Kronos-base, Hugging Face
